note: P4164 (Pro 21:13) — whoever closes his ear to the poor's cry will himself cry out unanswered. (dal 'poor' = standalone.)

dims.v: unanswered cry — the pitiless man's own cry goes unheard
the crying-out of the one who closed his ear to the poor — his own cry will go unanswered
the measure-for-measure silence that meets the pitiless

qara (call/cry out) — 'whoever closes his ear to the cry of the poor will himself CALL OUT and not be answered'; the merciless man's own cry is met with the silence he gave the poor. Measure-for-measure justice — mercy withheld is mercy denied (cf 14:31; Matt 5:7).
